result.reason: The redline appropriately limits TrueLink’s licence to service delivery, prohibits resale and other exploitation, and confirms Client ownership of Credit Data. It is narrowly tailored and preserves the operational processing licence. However, it does not address ownership or assignment of deliverables/work product, embedded Vendor IP licensing, or the fallback deliverables licence, so it does not fully reach the supplied playbook position. Drafting is generally professional, though the licence term is only implied by the heading and “Client Content” may require a defined term.
